_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. EVERY IDENTITY IN THIS FILE IS FAKE. This is not a real mission configuration and does not describe a real deployment, location, or group. No real mission configuration is ever committed to this repository; a real package belongs in mission/local/, which is git-ignored. See SECURITY.md.
_violates: network.address_prefix is '2001:db8::/32', which is not a well-formed IPv4 CIDR. FML-ADR-063 made the field a per-deployment IPv4 prefix and the schema now constrains it with a pattern, so a non-IPv4-CIDR value is rejected. This example exists so that the addressing-configuration check is itself tested; without the pattern it would validate.

mission.name: Example with a malformed address prefix, fictional

notes: Fictional example package used to exercise the schema. Contains no real identity, location, callsign or credential.
